THE PROJECT IN A NUTSHELL

A specific place.
A specific solution.

Solution area
Domestic wastewater treatment plants / Rainwater management / Pumping stations and related technology
Project period
12 / 2025
Technology
ASIO MONOCOMP 4 PB, ASIO REVO and ASIO KRECHT
Scope of work

HOW IT WENT

From the brief
to the finished solution.

Read the full story of the project, the technology used and the individual steps.

Original reference

01In Žďár u Písku we delivered a comprehensive wastewater treatment and rainwater management solution…

In Žďár u Písku we delivered a comprehensive wastewater treatment and rainwater management solution for a family house, taking account of the high groundwater level and the unsuitable subsoil for infiltration at the site.

The project included an ASIO MONOCOMP 4 PB domestic WWTP, i.e. a standard version with factory-fitted reinforcement and formwork for concrete encasement, suited to demanding hydrogeological conditions. A storage tank was supplied in the same PB design, intended for safe concrete encasement and stable bedding in the subsoil.

02Sewage from the family house flows directly into the wastewater treatment plant.

Sewage from the family house flows directly into the wastewater treatment plant. Treated water from the WWTP runs into a storage tank, which serves both to collect the treated water and as a collector and safety overflow for the rainwater tank.

The storage tank has an emergency overflow discharging into a soakaway built with ASIO KRECHT technology, which acts as a passive safety feature. However, because of the poor infiltration conditions at the site, the system had to be supplemented with active pumping of excess water away from the property.

03For this reason, both the storage tank and the rainwater tank are fitted with submersible pumps with float…

For this reason, both the storage tank and the rainwater tank are fitted with submersible pumps with float switches, which automatically pump excess water away from the property when the level rises, keeping the whole system running safely and stably.

The solution also includes an ASIO REVO inspection chamber, which allows the outflow to be checked or samples of the treated water to be taken. All the technology is also fitted with visual and audible signalling of fault and emergency states, so operation can be checked quickly and the operator can respond immediately.

04The wastewater treatment plant is also ready for chemical dosing to reduce the phosphorus concentration in…

The wastewater treatment plant is also ready for chemical dosing to reduce the phosphorus concentration in the wastewater.
The technology also includes a stainless-steel basket for easy capture and removal of excess sludge. This solution eliminates the need for jute sacks, lowers operating costs and at the same time prevents the risk of the sacks decomposing in the plant, which makes maintenance of the whole system considerably easier.

Rainwater from the building's roofs is channelled into a rainwater tank, which besides its safety function also allows the rainwater to be used – for spraying over the plot, with provision for pumping it back into the house (toilet flushing, non-potable water).

05The whole system is designed as an interlinked, safe and operationally stable solution that respects…

The whole system is designed as an interlinked, safe and operationally stable solution that respects the local hydrogeological conditions, minimises operating risks and at the same time allows efficient water management.
